Hi Emy, very good catch, it looks like a diamond.and it is. And what diamond says? Stay away or go time frame lower or higher to see what is going on with price structure. Diamonds are indecision pattern, they can reverse or continue.

In current EU it can be a flag to LTF demand, but with strong bears LTF's demands can be easily broken.

As you can see there is lots of questions and more PA is needed to trade it.

Notice that at my old chart I bought, but not the diamond but demand.

My advice on this TF is just wait, It won't cost you anything.

Diamonds once again.

IMO, the biggest danger in blind diamond trading is fact that pattern is compressed above and below current price, so if you're wrong in judgment you will lose at least half diamond height in pip terms.

Also you can trade it after break and pullback.
